test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Armature and Coil Winder) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a DC motor's winding table, if the number of poles is increased, what will likely happen to the number of armature slots?

options.text: The number of slots will remain unchanged regardless of pole count
The number of slots will increase to accommodate the additional coils.
The number of slots will increase, but only by one per additional pole.
The number of slots will decrease in proportion to the increase in poles.

solution:
The correct answer is __The number of slots will increase to accommodate the additional coils.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The number of armature slots corresponds to the number of poles and the winding configuration.
 
• Increasing the number of poles often requires more armature slots to accommodate the additional coils.
 
• This ensures proper distribution of the armature winding and helps maintain the efficiency of the motor.
 
• The relationship between poles and armature slots depends on the specific design and operational requirements of the motor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Impact of Pole Count:**

 
 
• More poles can lead to smoother operation and lower speed in a DC motor.
 
• However, increasing poles also adds complexity to the design and manufacturing process.
 
 
 
• **Armature Slot Design:**
 
 
• Proper design of armature slots is crucial to minimize losses and improve motor performance.
 
• Slot size, shape, and insulation play a significant role in determining the motor's efficiency.
